receiptUri.description: AT-URI of the purchase.receipt this consent record accompanies.

receiptCid.description: CID of the receipt at time of consent. Links consent to a specific, immutable receipt state.

licenseGrant.description: License terms the buyer consented to. cid is the exact version agreed to — not a future or past version.

consentedAt.description: Timestamp of affirmative consent. Combined with the PDS record's creation timestamp forms a tamper-evident assertion of when consent was given.

appSig.description: Base64url signature by the storefront service keypair (storefrontDid — see purchase.receipt) over SHA-256(buyerDid:licenseGrant.cid:receiptCid:consentedAt). All four values are colon-delimited in the order listed. buyerDid is the authenticated consenting party at mint time -- not a stored field, since the consent record's own repo already establishes whose consent this is; verifiers supply their own session DID when reconstructing the payload. Prevents consent records being fabricated outside the app's trust boundary. Verifiers reconstruct this payload from the consent record's plaintext fields and verify against the public key resolved from storefrontDid — using kid to select the correct historical key if the keypair has been rotated. Immutable.

kid.description: Key identifier for the storefront service keypair that produced appSig. Format: storefront-key-{YYYY-MM-DD} where the date is the keypair's activation date, e.g. storefront-key-2026-08-29. Allows verifiers to select the correct historical key from the storefrontDid DID document verificationMethod array without trying all keys exhaustively. kid is a hint — verifiers still verify cryptographically and should fall back to trying all non-revoked keys if the hinted key fails. Immutable.
